why: Fifty-plus notification call sites across shutterflow and argo need one intent-to-priority queue that exists before the toast viewport mounts.
what: packages/basalt-ui/src/core/notify*, src/page/toast* (ToastHost). Created here; ui/toast parts come from v3-prim-p4-overlays.
must_not_touch: CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATING.md, llms.txt, scripts/check-budgets/** except areas/surface.ts, other areas' migrations files
contract: Frozen: ARCHITECTURE.md, src/core/ports.ts. Need a change: factory signal, take the reversible default. Read concepts/state-persistence-forms.md sections 5, 6, 9 and ARCHITECTURE sections 1 and 3 (symbol allotment of '.' and './data'). notify is a queue in core (no Base UI import); ToastHost in ./page is an explicit child. Provider closure test: BasaltProvider must not pull notify or the toast chunk.
exemplar: Queue shape: 2.x src/provider/notifier.ts. Parts: src/ui/toast* (v3-prim-p4-overlays). Layout test style: tests/layout/cards-exemplar*.
change: notify(kind, payload) returning an id; kinds error, success, info, warning from BasaltRegister (app-augmentable, entries may carry onShow); payload {message,title?,autoClose?,undo?:{revert,windowMs?=8000}}. Intent to priority: errors persistent, others 5 s, explicit autoClose clamps to at least 5000 (valueShift), 1,500 ms dedup. Queue cap 50 until a host mounts; dev warning after 3 s without a host. ToastHost renders ui/toast with viewport label key toast.viewport and dismiss toast.dismiss; never moves focus. Rule: none new (direct toast.add outside notify is flagged by import-boundary in the lint Issues). Skill: generated docs/notify.md. Tests: intent map, floor, dedup, undo.revert once, queue cap, no-host warning, S5 (notify before the viewport chunk loads is not dropped). A new public value symbol also lands, in this Issue, its raise in scripts/check-budgets/areas/surface.ts (the ceiling +1 and a `raises` row with from, to, consumer and repo) and its name in scripts/consumers.json (`<symbol>: <repo>:<path>`); make check refuses the symbol without them. The shard is scripts/export-surface/index/page.json, written by `export-surface.mjs --update`.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: bun test plus a layout test (tests/layout/toast-viewport.layout.test.ts on tests/layout/fixture/toast-viewport-fixture.tsx) of the toast viewport at 1800x1200 and 390x844 (print:hidden asserted).
acceptance: intent to priority map test: error persistent, info and success 5 s, explicit autoClose 2000 resolves to 5000
notify before ToastHost mounts is delivered after mount (S5) and the queue never exceeds 50
undo.revert runs exactly once; the app's own revert call and the toast action share it
a duplicate payload within 1,500 ms shows one toast
the provider-only fixture's bundle contains neither notify nor the toast chunk (provider closure test)
axe: viewport is a named region, aria-live polite, an error mirrors into role=alert
git diff --name-only lists only owned paths
out_of_scope: Argo inbox and NotificationBell (recipe over onShow), migration rows for notifyError and friends, ui/toast parts, OverlayHost.
